description: batch-fixed's EBCDIC batch after a copybook-aware transfer to ASCII, read under the ASCII charset and the translated-EBCDIC sign convention while its descriptor still resolves every type code under cp037: each discriminator literal is re-expressed character by character, and the packed and binary items are carried as they are.
source: docs/ir/SPEC.md, "A consumer may read under other axes, and re-expresses what it compares" and "Each axis carries a literal the way a file crosses it"; the detail record's items are cobol-go codec/SPEC.md, Appendix A, A.7 rows 1 and 3
